name: Destiny 2
native_kbm_note: Bungie supports a keyboard on consoles only for text chat (help.bungie.net/hc/en-us/articles/360048719292). Mein-MMO's PS5/PS4 KBM test lists Destiny 2 as 'Nein' (no support). Push Square's KBM list includes Destiny 2 with no detail, probably because of the chat keyboard.
notes: PC defaults are toggle sprint (Shift) and toggle crouch (Ctrl); PS5 uses L3 for sprint and Circle for crouch. Class ability (V) is a Circle hold on PS5 and crouch is a Circle tap. Interact (E) is a Square hold on PS5 and reload (R) is a Square tap. Weapon slots 1/2/3 and the wheel have no direct PS5 equivalent: Triangle tap swaps kinetic/energy and Triangle hold takes the heavy weapon, so 1/2 map to Triangle and 3 to Triangle (hold). Ghost (Tab) is a Touchpad press; Director/map (M) is a Touchpad hold. Super is L1+R1 together. Emotes are on the D-pad (arrow keys on PC).
